title: Teaching the Child Salah and the Importance of the Righteous Example

text_simplified: Parents must teach their children salah and accustom them to it from a young age, while observing rifq (gentleness) and tenderness in guidance. They should also be a righteous example for their children in performing acts of worship. The noble Prophetic hadith encourages teaching the child salah when they reach the age of seven.
